correctness.rationale: For every fixed alpha>0 and xi>0, direct expansion of S_L(x)=(1+xi*x/(1+xi))exp(-xi*x) yields S_L~xi/(1+xi)*x*exp(-xi*x). The exact DUS tail 1-H=e(1-exp(-S_L))/(e-1) has derivative e/(e-1) at S_L=0, and the APT map has derivative alpha*log(alpha)/(alpha-1)>0 at H=1 (equal to one when alpha=1). Their product proves the stated K(alpha,xi)>0; differentiating the exact CDF yields f~xi*K*x*exp(-xi*x), so the hazard limit is xi. Tail integration for positive t proves the MGF converges precisely t<xi; for t<=0 finiteness follows from X>=0, and divergence at t=xi gives radius xi of the nonnegative-coefficient moment series. Explicit alpha=1 and alpha<1 parameter boundaries were checked analytically. The exact proof, not a finite numerical plot, supports all-parameter statements.

This is a targeted correction of a consequential model interpretation, not merely a routine renaming of a distribution; asymptotic and finite-sample flexibility are carefully distinguished.
